A Global Market Leader

Established in 2010, MentorsEdgepro is an innovative, market leading provider of online trading services. Today MentorsEdgepro is a multi-regulated broker with offices across the globe including Australia, Asia, Japan, Europe, UK, UAE, South Africa and clients in more than 165 countries.

At MentorsEdgepro, we strive to provide the best in financial services. We strive for success and excellence in all of our endeavors.

Serving millions of clients across the globe. With a passionate working team, we are connecting the global financial markets to make a more open and equitable economic future.


Our vision

To build the world’s most powerful app for copytrading.


Our mission

We are committed to excellence by continuously refining our services to cater to the needs of our stakeholders by setting new goals and expanding our network of products with constant improvement and innovation.

Why traders choose us

Tight spreads

Enjoy lower trading costs and potential higher returns with our tight spreads.

Reliable execution

Receive reliable execution with our data partner, Equinix, one of the world’s largest data centres.

24/7 client support

Our client support team speaks 20+ languages and is available anytime you need. 

Data security

Trade with a secure broker that employs the latest encryption technology. 

Free education

Discover free in-depth articles and videos to enhance your trading knowledge.

4,000+ instruments

Trade on a global scale with 4,000 instruments available across global markets.

A brand with a global presence

Our global team is here to support you every step of the way. 


Committed to your success

At MentorsEdgepro, we are committed to enhancing the trading journey of our clients by providing them with excellent conditions, cutting-edge tools, in-depth educational resources and world-class customer support. 

Whether you’re a new or experienced trader, MentorsEdgepro is here to help you maximise your trading potential.
